svg.text: House concept / authored Bevy blockout • six main levels + tower gallery
Plan views: back of house at top; street at bottom. Exact furniture and final art remain iterative.
Rail station, elevated tracks, control desk
Rooftop trees, tower door, windmill mast
THE VERY TOP / LISTENING & DYNAMO GALLERY
Red tower door → yellow ladder → windmill control cabinet
Stopping the exterior rotor permits the greenhouse generator to be switched off.
Power loss makes the freezer keycard available. The crowbar removes the basement boards.
Working: colored locks, ladder interaction, windmill, generator, freezer and basement gate.
Designed / exterior blockout: hanging fear shed, water tank circuit, annex shortcuts and fear spaces.
MORNING → AFTERNOON → EVENING → NIGHT → NEXT DAY
Mystery is carried by architecture, clues, subdued materials and sound—not a permanently dark sky.
